verdict.rationale: Snowflake's docs say resource monitors track warehouse credit usage and can suspend a standard virtual warehouse when it hits a credit limit. That is a native hard stop on runaway spend. Supporting pieces include GA per-user quotas, cost anomaly monitors (preview) with GA notification integrations, and user-controlled warehouse start/stop. A community user also independently recommends resource monitors to keep costs from ballooning. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of warehouse auto-suspend on idle, per-query timeouts that kill a single runaway query, and detail on how per-user quotas enforce limits.
